evidence_classes.E0: Design-derived scenario: author-constructed from estate architecture; no retained production record.
evidence_classes.E1: Retrospective architect note: post hoc operational recollection; no ticket, log, or configuration retained for review.
evidence_classes.E2: Privately ticket-reviewed reconstruction: internal reconstruction reviewed by the author; public release limited to an anonymized paraphrase.
evidence_classes.E3: Artifact-reproduced mechanism: a synthetic runnable artifact reproduces the stated mechanism under explicitly bounded assumptions. E3 attaches to the mechanism, never to the original operational event.
